newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean stocks up a notch, held back by Dow fall.
newsitem.headline: Chilean stocks up a notch, held back by Dow fall.

text.p: Chilean stocks inched higher in very light morning trade, as the sinking Dow stymied expectations for a technical bounce after a flat week, brokers said.
"The Dow is falling and I think locally we're looking at a pretty flat day," a broker said.
Prospects for a cut in interest rates in June or July, as most analysts expect, was providing some foundation to the market, but brokers were held back by Wall Street's 42-point drop this morning.
The blue-chip IPSA index rose 0.09 percent to 118.93 points and the all-share IGPA was up 0.02 percent to 5336 points after about 45 minutes of trade.
Electric stocks were mostly higher, with Endesa up 0.6 percent to 255.50 pesos. Telecom de Chile, subject of merger speculation with competitor VTR, was off 0.07 percent to 3225 pesos.
